item.content:encoded:
Minor edit: In the third paragraph of containment procedures, I changed "The area of within 2 km radius of SCP-836 outbreak" to "The area within a 2 km radius of a SCP-836 outbreak".

I like the idea in question here, of a "building disease" that spreads unabated without intervention. From reading the comments, it seems that this page has likely been cleaned up quite a bit since its inception, but I still found a lot of little bits and pieces that stuck out to me as incorrect, or having weird structure and/or flow.

+ Grammar & Word Choice
- Nitpicks Ahoy!
  • "In the event of inner casing breach, outer casing" I feel like this should be "In the event of an inner casing breach, the outer casing".
  • "procedure 28-Surtur" I think procedure should be capitalized in this instance.
  • "though the likelihood of SCP-836 appearance increases rapidly" as noted by another commentor, 'rapidly' is not the correct word here. Rapid denotes speed, and there's no element of speed here, just an increase in likelihood. Perhaps "increases substantially"?
  • "seems to correspond to a density drop" I think this would be read better as "The mass increase has a 1:1 correlation with a density drop in surrounding material".
  • All three stages should have both words capitalized, and should be preceded by an (unbolded) "its" or "the". "its Growth Stage" or "the Growth Stage", for example.
  • "examination has shown this to be in fact separate loops" The "in fact" interjection is unnecessary here.
  • "At this point, the deformations often superficially mimic the surrounding environment"
  • "resulting in outside resemblance to structural features" I don't have a specific substitute suggestion here, but this feels both awkward grammatically and non-clinical in word choice.
  • "Along with uniform density drops in the surrounding material"
  • "first encountered by the Foundation on ██/██/199█" Hiding only the exact year serves no purpose here; showing us that it's in the 90's says a lot, just pick a year if you're going to go that far.
  • "the local police of an apartment house " I think this should be apartment complex instead.
  • "Upon arrival at the site"
+ Content Questions & Suggestions
- The Big Bois
  • When discussing building codes in the containment procedures, I don't think "should be edited" has quite enough specificity. Although the implication is clear, I think it would read better if it said something like "efforts should be made to lobby or infiltrate appropriate legislative bodies to edit existing building codes, such that structures over 70 years of age receive systematic replacement of individual components".
  • When you refer to "most known structural materials", there needs to be some elaboration. This spreads through contact among other vectors; will a lone cinder block in contact become infected? How about a statue? Iron cookware? Is this affecting things purely based on material of composition, or is it infecting based on how that material is structured, IE it only infects things that could be considered a "building" or part of a "building"? If it's the latter, that's another anomalous property that should be noted. If the former, some additional clarity would be good to help the scientific/clinical tone.
  • "at this stage can grow by re-purposing entire sections of its surroundings" This really needs to be elaborated upon. "Surroundings" how? At what range? Only objects stored within the infected building, only within rooms in the infected building, only in direct contact?
  • "It has been shown that heating instances of SCP-836 to over 950 degrees Celsius for up to 4 minutes neutralizes most non-metallic samples" 'Most' indicates that there are outliers, but there's nothing noted in the containment procedures about what to do if the 950 degree procedure fails (even if what to do is something like "if this sterilization technique fails, there is no alternative treatment at this time and the panel in question must be treated and contained as a new instance of SCP-836"). On a similar topic, the bit about warm nitric acid should be mentioned somewhere in containment.
  • "during a period of two months - causing suspicion of cannabis indica farming." That last bit is not structured correctly for a formal report. That sentence should end with the period, and then the bit about pot farming suspicions moved to the next paragraph. "Police records indicate that the building was investigated under suspicion of illegal cultivation of cannabis indica. The report given by the returning officer prompted a Foundation investigation, led by Agent Dolezal.
  • Given that this seems to be something that can occur spontaneously (or, at least, can regularly occur in the outside world even if the SCP doesn't breach), there really needs to be some mention of it being uncontained, or at least tagged as such.

-1 for now, but I eagerly await changing that to a +1 after some more clean-up.
